news.titleTr: Çinli otomobiller Avrupa'da güvenlik kıskacında: BYD için kritik başvuru
news.summaryTr: Avrupa Parlamentosu üyeleri, güvenlik risklerini gerekçe göstererek Çinli otomobil üreticisi BYD'nin kamu alımlarından çıkarılmasını ve araçlarının askeri tesisler ile stratejik bölgelere girişinin kısıtlanmasını istedi. Milletvekilleri, bağlantılı araçlardaki kamera, GPS ve sensörlerin casusluk ama
news.articleText: Çinli otomobiller Avrupa'da güvenlik kıskacında: BYD için kritik başvuru - Avrupa Parlamentosu üyeleri, güvenlik risklerini gerekçe göstererek Çinli otomobil üreticisi BYD'nin kamu alımlarından çıkarılmasını ve araçlarının askeri tesisler ile stratejik bölgelere girişinin kısıtlanmasını istedi. - Milletvekilleri, bağlantılı araçlardaki kamera, GPS ve sensörlerin casusluk amacıyla kullanılabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Avrupa'da Çinli otomobil üreticilerine yönelik güvenlik endişeleri gündeme taşındı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Avrupa Parlamentosunun (AP) bazı üyeleri, Çin merkezli BYD'nin kamu alımlarından dışlanması ve araçlarının askeri tesisler ile hassas altyapılara erişiminin sınırlandırılması için Avrupa Birliği (AB) Komisyonuna başvurdu. AP üyesi Francois Kalfon, kişisel internet sitesinden yaptığı açıklamada, 8 milletvekiliyle birlikte Çinli şirketlerin ürettiği bağlantılı araçların oluşturabileceği casusluk risklerine ilişkin AB Komisyonuna başvurduklarını bildirdi. Kalfon ayrıca Fransa Başbakanı Sebastien Lecornu'ya da konuyla ilgili mektup gönderdi. Kameralar ve GPS sistemleri güvenlik riski olarak gösterildi Başvuruda, bağlantılı araçlarda bulunan kameralar, GPS sistemleri, mikrofonlar ve lazer sensörlerinin hassas verilerin toplanmasında kullanılabileceği savunuldu. Bu teknolojilerin özellikle askeri üsler ve stratejik altyapıların yakınında güvenlik riski oluşturabileceği öne sürüldü. Açıklamada, İngiltere ve Polonya'nın Çinli şirketler tarafından üretilen araçların askeri tesislere erişimini kısıtladığı, ABD ordusunun da Japonya'daki üssünde BYD araçlarının kullanımını yasakladığı belirtildi. Fransa'nın ise henüz benzer önlemleri hayata geçirmediğine dikkat çekildi. BYD için Avrupa'da yeni kısıtlama talebi Milletvekilleri, Fransa ve AB'nin önlem almak için kanıtlanmış bir casusluk vakasının ortaya çıkmasını beklememesi gerektiğini savundu. Hibrit savaş ortamında stratejik tesislerin korunması için hızlı hareket edilmesi çağrısı yapıldı. Fransız hükümeti ve AB Komisyonu'ndan BYD araçlarının askeri tesisler ile hassas altyapılara erişiminin sınırlandırılması ve şirketin kamu alımlarından çıkarılması istendi. Ayrıca müzakereleri devam eden AB siber güvenlik düzenlemesi kapsamında BYD'nin yüksek riskli tedarikçi olarak sınıflandırılması ve şirketin araçlarının Avrupa'ya ithalatının sınırlandırılması çağrısında bulunuldu. Bağlantılı otomobiller neden güvenlik tartışmalarının odağında? Bağlantılı otomobiller, kamera, konum belirleme, mikrofon ve çevresel algılama sistemleri sayesinde sürekli veri üretebiliyor. Bu veriler sürüş güvenliği ve araç içi hizmetler için kullanılırken, hassas bölgelerde veri güvenliği ve bu bilgilere kimlerin erişebildiği konusunda soru işaretleri yaratabiliyor. Avrupa'da Çinli teknoloji ve otomobil şirketlerine yönelik güvenlik incelemeleri de bu tartışmaların bir parçası haline geliyor.

CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sardinya Adası'nda bulunan Ollolai Belediyesi'nin yürüttüğü Work From Ollolai programı kapsamında, farklı mesleklerden kişiler bir ay boyunca sembolik kira bedeliyle kasabada yaşayabiliyor. Programla, farklı ülkelerden gelen profesyonellerin bilgi ve deneyimlerini yerel halkla paylaşması, kasaba sakinlerinin yeni meslekler ve çalışma yöntemleriyle tanışması amaçlanıyor. Konaklama karşılığında bilgi ve deneyim paylaşımı Programa kabul edilen katılımcılardan uzmanlık alanlarına göre halka açık sunumlar yapmaları, ders vermeleri veya yerel projelere katkı sunmaları isteniyor. Bu kapsamda teknoloji, medya, finans, emlak ve mimarlık alanlarında çalışan profesyoneller ile girişimciler öncelikli başvuru grupları arasında yer alıyor. Sanatçılar, yazarlar, müzisyenler, bilim insanları ve akademisyenler de programa başvurabiliyor. Bir veya iki yatak odalı evlerde kalabilecekler Program kapsamında katılımcılara müsaitlik durumuna göre bir veya iki yatak odalı evler tahsis ediliyor. Ev sahibiyle sembolik 1 euro kira bedeli üzerinden sözleşme imzalanıyor. Konaklama süresi en fazla bir ay olarak belirlenirken, daha uzun süre kalmak isteyenlerin talepleri ayrıca değerlendiriliyor. Yemek ve ulaşım masrafları katılımcılara ait Bir euroluk ödeme yalnızca kira bedelini kapsıyor. Yemek, faturalar, depozito ve ulaşım giderleri katılımcılar tarafından karşılanıyor. Belediye, vize ve vergi işlemlerinde de destek sağlamıyor. Bu nedenle programa katılmak isteyenlerin seyahat öncesinde vize ve diğer yasal gereklilikleri araştırması gerekiyor. 1 euroluk ev satışlarıyla da gündeme gelmişti Sardinya Adası'nda, uzun yaşam süreleriyle öne çıkan Mavi Bölge'nin bulunduğu coğrafyada yer alan Ollolai, daha önce 1 euroluk ev satışlarıyla gündeme gelmişti. Kasabada kalıcı olarak yaşamak isteyenlere yönelik bu uygulama, Work From Ollolai kapsamında sunulan bir aylık konaklama programından ayrı yürütülüyor. Sardinya'nın Mavi Bölge özelliği Sardinya Adası'nın bazı bölgeleri, dünyada insanların 100 yaşını aşma oranlarının yüksek olduğu yerleri tanımlamak için kullanılan "Mavi Bölge" kavramıyla anılıyor. Beslenme alışkanlıkları, günlük fiziksel hareketlilik, sosyal ilişkiler ve yaşam biçimi bu bölgelerde uzun yaşamla ilişkilendirilen başlıca unsurlar arasında gösteriliyor.

news.title: Trump'tan İran savaşında sürpriz hamle: Devreye Çin girdi
news.summary: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump yönetiminin, İran'la savaşı sona erdirmek için Çin'den yardım istediği öne sürüldü. Washington Post'un haberine göre Pekin, ABD'nin mesajını Tahran'a iletirken, Trump'ın Şi Cinping ile yapacağı görüşmede İran konusunun ele alınması bekleniyor.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Trump'tan İran savaşında sürpriz hamle: Devreye Çin girdi
news.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump yönetiminin, İran'la savaşı sona erdirmek için Çin'den yardım istediği öne sürüldü. Washington Post'un haberine göre Pekin, ABD'nin mesajını Tahran'a iletirken, Trump'ın Şi Cinping ile yapacağı görüşmede İran konusunun ele alınması bekleniyor.
news.articleText: Trump'tan İran savaşında sürpriz hamle: Devreye Çin girdi - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump yönetiminin, İran'la savaşı sona erdirmek için Çin'den yardım istediği öne sürüldü. Washington Post'un haberine göre Pekin, ABD'nin mesajını Tahran'a iletirken, Trump'ın Şi Cinping ile yapacağı görüşmede İran konusunun ele alınması bekleniyor. Washington Post (WP) gazetesinin ABD'li ve Avrupalı yetkililere dayandırdığı habere göre, ABD'de savaşa yönelik kamuoyu tepkisinin artması, Trump yönetimini diplomatik çözüm arayışlarını hızlandırmaya yöneltti. İran'la savaşın sona erdirilmesi, yönetimin karşı karşıya olduğu en acil ve zorlu meselelerden biri olarak değerlendiriliyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Haberde, ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent'in Trump'ın desteğiyle Çin hükümetiyle temasa geçtiği belirtildi. Bessent'in, Pekin yönetiminden İran üzerindeki nüfuzunu kullanarak savaşın sona erdirilmesine katkıda bulunmasını istediği öne sürüldü. Çin'in de ABD'den gelen mesajı Tahran yönetimine ilettiği iddia edildi. Gözler 18 Kasım'daki görüşmede Diplomatik temasların sürdüğü bir dönemde, Trump'ın 18 Kasım'da Çin'de Devlet Başkanı Şi Cinping ile gerçekleştirmesi planlanan görüşmede İran meselesinin de gündeme gelmesi bekleniyor. Görüşmeye Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin'in de katılabileceği iddia edilirken, üç liderin aynı masada buluşup buluşmayacağına ilişkin henüz resmi bir açıklama yapılmadı. Öte yandan Çin'in Orta Doğu Özel Temsilcisi Büyükelçi Cay Cün'ün de savaşın sona erdirilmesine yönelik diplomatik girişimler kapsamında İran, Umman ve Suudi Arabistan'ı ziyaret etmesi bekleniyor.

news.title: Shaquille O'Neal'dan iflasa karşı emeklilik planı: Her ay 1 milyon dolar alacak!
news.summary: NBA efsanesi Shaquille O'Neal, servetini kaybetme ihtimaline karşı yıllar önce yaptığı yatırımı açıkladı. Ünlü basketbolcu, 55 yaşından itibaren emeklilik gelir sigortası sayesinde ayda yaklaşık 1 milyon dolar gelir elde etmeyi beklediğini söyledi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Shaquille O'Neal'dan iflasa karşı emeklilik planı: Her ay 1 milyon dolar alacak!
news.summaryTr: NBA efsanesi Shaquille O'Neal, servetini kaybetme ihtimaline karşı yıllar önce yaptığı yatırımı açıkladı. Ünlü basketbolcu, 55 yaşından itibaren emeklilik gelir sigortası sayesinde ayda yaklaşık 1 milyon dolar gelir elde etmeyi beklediğini söyledi.
news.articleText: Shaquille O'Neal'dan iflasa karşı emeklilik planı: Her ay 1 milyon dolar alacak! NBA efsanesi Shaquille O'Neal, servetini kaybetme ihtimaline karşı yıllar önce yaptığı yatırımı açıkladı. Ünlü basketbolcu, 55 yaşından itibaren emeklilik gelir sigortası sayesinde ayda yaklaşık 1 milyon dolar gelir elde etmeyi beklediğini söyledi. Basketbol tarihinin en tanınmış isimlerinden Shaquille O'Neal, milyonlarca dolarlık servetini nasıl koruduğunu ve gelecekteki gelirini nasıl güvence altına aldığını anlattı. "Dinner Party" podcast'ine konuk olan dört NBA şampiyonluğu sahibi eski basketbolcu, genç yaşta kazandığı büyük paraları harcama alışkanlığından nasıl vazgeçtiğini ve yıllar önce aldığı finansal kararların bugün kendisine nasıl bir güvence sağladığını paylaştı. O'Neal, yatırımlarının başarısız olması veya servetini kaybetmesi ihtimaline karşı kazancının önemli bir bölümünü düzenli gelir sağlayan emeklilik ürünlerine yönlendirdiğini söyledi. Ünlü basketbolcu, bu yatırımlar sayesinde gelecek yıl 55 yaşına geldiğinde aylık yaklaşık 1 milyon dolar gelir elde etmeyi beklediğini açıkladı. Zengin bir adamın peçeteyle verdiği ders hayatını değiştirdi O'Neal'ın finansal yaklaşımının değişmesinde yıllar önce tanıştığı varlıklı bir kişinin önemli rolü oldu. Ünlü basketbolcu, lüks otomobillere ve gösterişli bir yaşam tarzına sahip olan bu kişiye servetini nasıl koruyabileceğini sorduğunu anlattı. Aldığı yanıt ise oldukça basitti. Zengin iş insanı, bir peçeteyi önce ikiye, ardından tekrar ikiye bölerek parasını dört parçaya ayırması gerektiğini gösterdi. O'Neal'a gelirinin yalnızca yüzde 25'ini harcamasını, kalan yüzde 75'ini ise biriktirmesini tavsiye etti. Gençliğinde savurganlığıyla dikkat çeken ve 20 yaşındayken tek bir günde 1 milyon dolar harcadığını daha önce açıklayan O'Neal, bu tavsiyenin ardından tasarrufa çok daha fazla önem vermeye başladığını söyledi. Servetini kaybetme ihtimaline karşı önlem aldı Basketboldan kazandığı milyonlarca doları farklı alanlarda değerlendiren O'Neal, bütün yatırımlarının başarılı olacağına güvenmek istemedi. Bu nedenle gelirinin önemli bir bölümünü, emeklilik döneminde kendisine düzenli ödeme yapılmasını sağlayacak finansal ürünlere aktardı. O'Neal, kararının arkasındaki düşünceyi, yatırımlarının başarısız olması veya beklenmedik gelişmeler yaşanması durumunda kendisine güvence oluşturmak istemesiyle açıkladı. ABD'de "annuity" olarak bilinen bu ürünler, sigorta şirketleri tarafından sunuluyor. Kişinin toplu para veya belirli dönemlerde prim ödemesi karşılığında gelecekte düzenli gelir elde etmesini sağlıyor. Ödemelerin tutarı ve süresi ise sözleşmenin koşullarına göre değişiyor. Ayda 1 milyon dolar gelir bekliyor Gelecek yılın bahar aylarında 55 yaşına girecek olan O'Neal, yıllar önce yaptığı bu yatırımların karşılığını almaya hazırlanıyor. Podcast sırasında emeklilik ürünlerinden ne kadar gelir beklediği sorulan eski basketbolcu, övünmek istemediğini ancak 55 yaşına geldiğinde aylık yaklaşık 1 milyon dolar alacağını düşündüğünü söyledi. Bu tutar, yılda yaklaşık 12 milyon dolarlık düzenli gelire karşılık geliyor. O'Neal, ödemelerin neredeyse hayatının geri kalanı boyunca devam etmesini beklediğini belirtti. Ancak ünlü basketbolcu, yatırdığı toplam tutara veya sözleşmelerinin ayrıntılarına ilişkin bilgi paylaşmadı. Çocuklarına servet için diploma şartı O'Neal, programda yalnızca yatırımlarını değil, çocuklarına yönelik servet yaklaşımını da anlattı. Çocuklarına sık sık "Biz zengin değiliz, ben zenginim" dediğini hatırlatan NBA efsanesi, aile servetinden yararlanabilmeleri için eğitimlerini tamamlamaları gerektiğini vurguladı. O'Neal, çocuklarından lisans ve yüksek lisans eğitimi almalarını beklediğini, aile parasına erişmek isteyenlerin iki veya üç diplomaya sahip olması gerektiğini söyledi. Kendisi de profesyonel basketbol kariyerine başladıktan sonra eğitimine devam eden O'Neal, lisans ve yüksek lisans derecelerinin yanı sıra eğitim alanında doktora derecesi aldı. Google yatırımından büyük kazanç sağladı O'Neal, podcast'te teknoloji devi Google'a yaptığı erken dönem yatırımı da yeniden gündeme getirdi. Bir otelin lobisinde tanıştığı kişinin kendisini henüz halka arz edilmemiş Google'a yatırım yapmaya davet ettiğini anlatan eski basketbolcu, finans danışmanıyla görüştükten sonra şirkete bir miktar para yatırdığını söyledi. Google'ın halka arzının ardından ilk yatırımcıların elde ettiği kazançları gazetelerden öğrendiğini belirten O'Neal, kendi yatırımından da önemli bir getiri sağladığını ifade etti. Ancak bu başarılı yatırımına rağmen 2009 yılındaki boşanmasında her şeyini kaybettiğini söyleyerek espri yaptı. O'Neal'ın anlattıkları, yüksek gelir elde etmenin yanında bu geliri korumaya yönelik uzun vadeli finansal planlamanın da servet yönetiminde önemli bir yer tuttuğunu ortaya koydu.

Bu nedenle gelirinin önemli bir bölümünü, emeklilik döneminde kendisine düzenli ödeme yapılmasını sağlayacak finansal ürünlere aktardı. O'Neal, kararının arkasındaki düşünceyi, yatırımlarının başarısız olması veya beklenmedik gelişmeler yaşanması durumunda kendisine güvence oluşturmak istemesiyle açıkladı. ABD'de "annuity" olarak bilinen bu ürünler, sigorta şirketleri tarafından sunuluyor. Kişinin toplu para veya belirli dönemlerde prim ödemesi karşılığında gelecekte düzenli gelir elde etmesini sağlıyor. Ödemelerin tutarı ve süresi ise sözleşmenin koşullarına göre değişiyor. Ayda 1 milyon dolar gelir bekliyor Gelecek yılın bahar aylarında 55 yaşına girecek olan O'Neal, yıllar önce yaptığı bu yatırımların karşılığını almaya hazırlanıyor. Podcast sırasında emeklilik ürünlerinden ne kadar gelir beklediği sorulan eski basketbolcu, övünmek istemediğini ancak 55 yaşına geldiğinde aylık yaklaşık 1 milyon dolar alacağını düşündüğünü söyledi. Bu tutar, yılda yaklaşık 12 milyon dolarlık düzenli gelire karşılık geliyor. O'Neal, ödemelerin neredeyse hayatının geri kalanı boyunca devam etmesini beklediğini belirtti. Ancak ünlü basketbolcu, yatırdığı toplam tutara veya sözleşmelerinin ayrıntılarına ilişkin bilgi paylaşmadı. Çocuklarına servet için diploma şartı O'Neal, programda yalnızca yatırımlarını değil, çocuklarına yönelik servet yaklaşımını da anlattı. Çocuklarına sık sık "Biz zengin değiliz, ben zenginim" dediğini hatırlatan NBA efsanesi, aile servetinden yararlanabilmeleri için eğitimlerini tamamlamaları gerektiğini vurguladı. O'Neal, çocuklarından lisans ve yüksek lisans eğitimi almalarını beklediğini, aile parasına erişmek isteyenlerin iki veya üç diplomaya sahip olması gerektiğini söyledi. Kendisi de profesyonel basketbol kariyerine başladıktan sonra eğitimine devam eden O'Neal, lisans ve yüksek lisans derecelerinin yanı sıra eğitim alanında doktora derecesi aldı. Google yatırımından büyük kazanç sağladı O'Neal, podcast'te teknoloji devi Google'a yaptığı erken dönem yatırımı da yeniden gündeme getirdi. Bir otelin lobisinde tanıştığı kişinin kendisini henüz halka arz edilmemiş Google'a yatırım yapmaya davet ettiğini anlatan eski basketbolcu, finans danışmanıyla görüştükten sonra şirkete bir miktar para yatırdığını söyledi. Google'ın halka arzının ardından ilk yatırımcıların elde ettiği kazançları gazetelerden öğrendiğini belirten O'Neal, kendi yatırımından da önemli bir getiri sağladığını ifade etti. Ancak bu başarılı yatırımına rağmen 2009 yılındaki boşanmasında her şeyini kaybettiğini söyleyerek espri yaptı. O'Neal'ın anlattıkları, yüksek gelir elde etmenin yanında bu geliri korumaya yönelik uzun vadeli finansal planlamanın da servet yönetiminde önemli bir yer tuttuğunu ortaya koydu.

news.summary: Altın fiyatları, yükselen tahvil faizlerinin baskısı altında dalgalanırken UniCredit, 2026 yıl sonu tahmin aralığını 3 bin 900-4 bin 500 dolar seviyesinde tuttu.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Altında faiz baskısına rağmen yükseliş umudu: Kritik tahmin açıklandı
news.summaryTr: Altın fiyatları, yükselen tahvil faizlerinin baskısı altında dalgalanırken UniCredit, 2026 yıl sonu tahmin aralığını 3 bin 900-4 bin 500 dolar seviyesinde tuttu.
news.articleText: Altında faiz baskısına rağmen yükseliş umudu: Kritik tahmin açıklandı Altın fiyatları, yükselen tahvil faizlerinin baskısı altında dalgalanırken UniCredit, 2026 yıl sonu tahmin aralığını 3 bin 900-4 bin 500 dolar seviyesinde tuttu. Altın fiyatları, haftanın son işlem gününde perşembe günkü yükselişin ardından yeniden geriledi. Ons altın, saat 16.50 GMT itibarıyla yüzde 0,54 düşüşle 4 bin 63,42 dolara indi. Buna karşın değerli metal, çarşamba günü 4 bin doların üzerine taşıdığı kazanımların büyük bölümünü korudu. UniCredit, kasım ayı değerlendirmesinde altın fiyatlarında kısa vadede dalgalı ve yatay bir seyrin devam edebileceğini belirtti. Banka, 2026 yıl sonu için ons altın tahmin aralığını 3 bin 900-4 bin 500 dolar olarak korudu. Bu aralığın, altının yıl sonuna kadar mutlaka 4 bin 500 dolara ulaşacağı anlamına gelmediği vurgulandı. Yükselen faizler altın üzerinde baskı oluşturuyor UniCredit'e göre, ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) daha uzun süre yüksek faiz politikasını sürdüreceği beklentisi ve yüksek reel faizler, altın fiyatlarının yükselişini sınırlayan temel unsurlar arasında yer alıyor. Ancak banka, tahvil faizlerindeki yükselişin nedeninin de önemli olduğuna dikkat çekti. Ekonomik büyümenin güçlenmesiyle artan faizlerin altın üzerinde baskı oluşturabileceği belirtilirken, bütçe açıkları ve kamu borcuna ilişkin endişeler nedeniyle yükselen faizlerin altını destekleyebileceği ifade edildi. Uzun vadeli tahvillerde yatırımcıların talep ettiği ek getiriyi ifade eden vade priminin, kamu maliyesine ilişkin risklerle yükselmesi durumunda yatırımcıların devlet tahvilleri dışındaki alternatif varlıklara yönelebileceği değerlendiriliyor. Altın fonlarında varlıklar rekor kırdı Altın fiyatlarındaki geri çekilmeye rağmen yatırımcı talebinde güçlü görünüm dikkat çekti. Dünya Altın Konseyi'nin ekim ayı raporuna göre, fiziki altın destekli borsa yatırım fonlarına (ETF) ekim ayında 2,7 milyar dolarlık giriş gerçekleşti. Bu girişlerle altın ETF'lerinin toplam varlığı ay sonunda 4 bin 275 tona ulaşarak rekor kırdı. Avrupa fonları girişlerde başı çekerken Asya'daki yatırımcılar da net alıcı konumunda kaldı. Kuzey Amerika fonlarında ise sınırlı çıkış görüldü. UniCredit, merkez bankalarının güçlü altın alımlarının, fonlardaki rekor varlıkların ve yatırımcıların portföylerini çeşitlendirme eğiliminin fiyatlardaki olası düşüşü sınırlayabileceğini belirtti. Borsalardaki düşüş altının güvenli liman rolünü yeniden gündeme getirdi Perşembe günü hisse senedi piyasalarında yaşanan satış dalgası sırasında altının performansı da dikkat çekti. JPMorgan'ın işlem masası değerlendirmesinde, altının S&P 500 endeksine kıyasla yaklaşık yüzde 5 daha iyi performans gösterdiği belirtildi. Bu gelişme, altının piyasalardaki belirsizlik dönemlerinde güvenli liman özelliğini yeniden öne çıkardı. Ancak tek günlük performansın, altının hisse senedi piyasalarındaki her düşüşte benzer bir koruma sağlayacağını göstermediği de değerlendiriliyor. UniCredit'ten altın fiyatları için kademeli toparlanma beklentisi UniCredit, yüksek faizlerin kısa vadede altının yükselişini sınırlayabileceğini, ancak yapısal talep ve kamu borcuna ilişkin risklerin fiyatlardaki aşağı yönlü hareketi frenleyebileceğini öngörüyor. Banka, bu unsurların etkisiyle altın fiyatlarında zaman içinde kademeli bir toparlanma yaşanabileceği görüşünü koruyor. Altın, faiz getirisi sunmayan bir yatırım aracı olduğu için reel faizlerin yükseldiği dönemlerde genellikle baskı altında kalıyor. Buna karşılık jeopolitik belirsizlikler, kamu borcuna ilişkin endişeler, merkez bankalarının altın alımları ve ETF girişleri değerli metale olan talebi artırabiliyor. Bu sebepten tahvil faizleri ile altın fiyatları arasındaki ilişki, faizlerin hangi ekonomik ve mali gelişmeler nedeniyle yükseldiğine bağlı olarak değişebiliyor.

news.title: Turistik Doğu Ekspresi için bilet fiyatları belli oldu
news.summary: Ankara-Kars hattında 21 Aralık’ta yeniden seferlerine başlayacak Turistik Doğu Ekspresi’nde iki kişilik kompartıman fiyatları Aralık ayında 15 bin TL’den başlayacak, sömestr tatilinde 20 bin TL’ye çıkacak.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Turistik Doğu Ekspresi için bilet fiyatları belli oldu
news.summaryTr: Ankara-Kars hattında 21 Aralık’ta yeniden seferlerine başlayacak Turistik Doğu Ekspresi’nde iki kişilik kompartıman fiyatları Aralık ayında 15 bin TL’den başlayacak, sömestr tatilinde 20 bin TL’ye çıkacak.
news.articleText: Turistik Doğu Ekspresi için bilet fiyatları belli oldu - Ankara-Kars hattında 21 Aralık’ta yeniden seferlerine başlayacak Turistik Doğu Ekspresi’nde iki kişilik kompartıman fiyatları Aralık ayında 15 bin TL’den başlayacak, sömestr tatilinde 20 bin TL’ye çıkacak. Kış turizminin gözde rotalarından Turistik Doğu Ekspresi, 2026-2027 sezonunda yeniden yolcularını ağırlamaya hazırlanıyor. Turistik Doğu Ekspresi ne zaman seferlere başlayacak? CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Ankara ile Kars arasında düzenlenecek seferlerin ilk hareket tarihi 21 Aralık olarak açıklandı. Tren, Ankara’dan Kars’a ilk yolculuğunu bu tarihte gerçekleştirecek. Dönüş seferi ise 23 Aralık’ta Kars’tan Ankara’ya yapılacak. İki kişilik kompartıman fiyatları ne kadar? Turistik Doğu Ekspresi’nde bilet fiyatları seyahat dönemine göre farklılık gösteriyor. İki kişinin konaklayabildiği kompartımanların fiyatı Aralık ayında 15 bin TL olarak belirlendi. Ocak ayının sonlarına doğru fiyat 18 bin TL'ye yükselirken, sömestr tatilinde iki kişilik kompartıman için 20 bin TL ödenecek. Biletlerin yüzde 40'ı doğrudan satılacak TCDD Taşımacılık A.Ş., Turistik Doğu Ekspresi biletlerinin yüzde 60'ını TÜRSAB onaylı seyahat acenteleri üzerinden satışa sunacak. Kalan yüzde 40'lık bölüm ise doğrudan vatandaşlara ayrılacak. Doğrudan satışa sunulan biletler TCDD'nin mobil uygulaması üzerinden alınabilecek. Acentelere ayrılan kontenjan için ise ilgili seyahat şirketlerine başvurulabilecek.

news.title: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt
news.summary: At least seven people died when two trains collided, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt
news.summaryTr: At least seven people died when two trains collided, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment.
news.articleText: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt A train collision has killed at least seven people and injured dozens in northern Egypt. Footage showed multiple overturned carriages and dozens of people surrounding them. One train was travelling from Giza to the Fayoum oasis, south west of Cairo, while the other was heading from Cairo to Aswan in the south. It is yet unclear what caused the accident but Egyptian President Abdul Fattah al-Sisi said an investigation was underway and would "hold accountable anyone who proves their negligence".

news.title: Government 'looking seriously' at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
news.summary: The culture secretary confirms reports they could be in the list of platforms set to be banned next March.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Government 'looking seriously' at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
news.summaryTr: The culture secretary confirms reports they could be in the list of platforms set to be banned next March.
news.articleText: Government 'looking seriously' at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay - Published Vinted and eBay could be included in the list of platforms set to be banned for children aged under 16, the culture secretary has said. Lisa Nandy said the government was "looking seriously" at including the retailing websites in the social media ban "to keep children safe". The UK's social media ban for under-16s is set to come into force in March next year, with children barred from accessing platforms such as Instagram, TikTok and Snapchat. In response, eBay said it was looking forward to "understanding more and continuing to work constructively with the government". Vinted said it welcomed "open dialogue" with ministers and the regulator on the issue. Asked on the BBC's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg programme whether the government was looking to ban under-16s from Vinted and eBay, Nandy said: "We are looking seriously at doing so in order to keep children safe." It came after the Sunday Times reported, external that the UK's social media ban was being expanded to include the popular second-hand online marketplaces. The move was due to fears that messaging functions on the platforms allowed strangers to groom children, according to the newspaper. It suggested similar reselling platforms, Depop and Facebook Marketplace, would also be included in the list of banned sites. Businesses and individuals sell a host of goods on eBay, which has been a major global player in the online reselling market for years. The platform states on its website that it currently requires all of its members to be over 18 years old because listings involve "entering into a contract". Vinted is aimed at over 18s, but its terms and conditions do allow parents or guardians to create accounts for their children, which must be used under parental supervision. The site, on which users mostly buy and sell unwanted clothes and other fashion items, has grown rapidly recently to reach 17 million UK users. A Vinted spokesperson said direct messaging was "part of how the platform works" but that it had a "zero tolerance for harmful or explicit content" and had moderation teams and tools to spot and remove "activity that breaks our rules". "When we identify inappropriate behaviour, we take action, up to a permanent ban or reporting to the relevant authorities," they said. An eBay spokesperson said the company was "focused on providing a trusted and safe marketplace experience for our millions of customers". "While the details of the proposed legislation are not yet clear, we look forward to understanding more and continuing to work constructively with the government," they added. The government announced it would ban under-16s accessing social media in June this year, with children prevented from accessing 10 of the biggest platforms. YouTube will also be banned for under-16s, but YouTube Kids - a version of the video-sharing app designed to be safe for children - will not be included in the measures. A complete list of affected platforms has not yet been released, but the government said it would cover those "whose purpose is to enable social interaction and which allow users to post material". That means platforms that have livestreaming or features that enable the potential for strangers to contact children will also be restricted, which includes gaming sites. It does not mean that Roblox, the biggest gaming site in the UK for those aged eight to 12, for example, will be banned for under-16s. However, certain features such as its chat function will be restricted. But Matthew Sinclair, a senior director at the Computer and Communications Industry Association, which represents tech companies, argued that ministers should prevent the rules having "scope creep". He said a restriction on messaging for under-16s "would not stop at social media and would reach into the services families depend on to stay in touch", and urged the government to "ensure any new restrictions are proportionate and effective." The UK's ban comes after a similar one was introduced in Australia last year. Many children there have found ways to get round it, but the UK has said it intends to take a tougher approach. In recent weeks, attention has turned to how a social media ban would be enforced. Last month, the communications regulator Ofcom set out its recommendations for the most effective ways to identify which of the UK's millions of social media users are aged over 16. Rani Govender, head of online child safety at the NSPCC, said the "real question" going forward was how the government ensured age checks were effective. "But effective age checks are only part of the solution," she added. "Tech companies must also be required to build child safety into every platform, device and AI tool, so children are protected from harmful and illegal content and only able to access age-appropriate services." news.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
news.summary: It is claimed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were part of anti-government protests earlier this year.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
news.summaryTr: It is claimed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were part of anti-government protests earlier this year.
news.articleText: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests - Published Iran has executed three men accused of carrying out armed unrest during January's anti-government protests, according to state media. Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were accused of throwing Molotov cocktails and grenades, using bladed weapons and firearms, and setting fire to public facilities in the city of Karaj, west of Tehran, Iran's state news agency Tasnim, external reported. The executions are the latest in a series linked to the protests, including those of people accused of having ties to Israel and the United States. The number of executions in Iran has increased since US-Israeli strikes on the Islamic Republic began in late February. The protest movement initially sparked in December last year by the high cost of living rapidly evolved into widespread anti-government demonstrations that peaked on 8 and 9 of January. Iranian authorities reported more than 3,000 deaths, and blamed the violence on "terrorist acts" orchestrated by the US and Israel. However foreign-based NGOs gave higher figures and the BBC received multiple accounts from Iranians of security forces opening fire on unarmed protesters. Tasnim reported that the three men were executed after the Supreme Court upheld their convictions and found them guilty of "participating in operational activities on behalf of the Israeli Zionist regime, the United States and hostile groups". The damage allegedly included an electricity substation in Karaj which caused power outages in some areas. Dioband was arrested on 11 January after investigations identified him as a suspect in attacks on public property and incitement to violence. Ten others accused of taking part in the unrest under his supervision were later arrested. Reuters news agency reports that they received prison terms of 5 to 10 years. The latest executions in Iran come after the UN human rights chief Volker Türk said he was alarmed by the rise in death penalties. In August, Türk said at least 56 people had been executed on national security-related charges since 19 March, including 27 in cases linked to January's nationwide anti-government protests. Iran is thought to be the world's second-most prolific executioner after China. Last year, it put to death at least 2,159 people, according to Amnesty International. The human rights group said that was the highest figure on record since 1981 and included 45 executions of suspected dissidents on national security-related charges. news.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto: Binance France is closing up shop in the country, as all accounts will be closed on Dec. 31. The US Treasury imposed financial sanctions on eight Canadian money-service companies it claims have done business with sanctioned Iranian entities, and the Treasury also moved to cut MEXC off from the US financial system over alleged illicit transactions. Binance France emails announce closure of accounts Dec. 31 Binance France is closing up shop in the country. Customers have been notified by email during early November, according to media reports. All accounts will be closed on Dec. 31, and any assets left on the exchange will be charged monthly fees starting on Nov. 29, Cryptoast, Crypto Briefing and other media reported on Saturday, citing emails sent to users by Binance. On that date, accounts still maintaining a balance will pay a monthly maintenance fee of 0.025% of the balance, or a minimum of 10 USDC, a stablecoin tracking the US dollar. To avoid fees, withdrawals must be completed by Nov. 29, the exchange said. US sanctions Canadian money-exchange firms over Iran ties The US Treasury imposed financial sanctions on eight Canadian money-service companies it claims have done business with sanctioned Iranian entities. These companies facilitated the exchange of Iranian rials and other currencies for digital assets, enabling international transactions, a US Treasury Department statement said on Friday. The sanctions, which serve to isolate the companies from the dollar-based financial system, are the latest in a series of Treasury moves against firms outside the US. These businesses have facilitated transactions with sanctioned Iranian digital asset exchanges, as well as with digital asset addresses associated with Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), according to the Treasury. US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions The US Department of Treasury on Friday issued an order to cut cryptocurrency exchange MEXC Global off from the US’ financial system after accusing it of facilitating at least $16 billion in transactions linked to sanctions evasion, cybercrime and other illicit activity. The Treasury’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) asserted that MEXC handled transactions involving sanctioned groups in Iran, Russia and North Korea between May 2021 and May 2026. This included around $1.5 billion in transactions linked to Russian sanctions evasion, according to the official press release. The order effectively bans US financial institutions from processing money transfers involving MEXC and will take effect 30 days after it is published in the Federal Register. “Financial institutions cannot have it both ways: Either you support the Iranian regime, or you have access to the U.S. financial system,” said Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent. “Treasury will continue to sever the Iranian regime’s economic lifelines and thwart its desperate attempts to circumvent U.S. sanctions using digital assets.” The action is part of Operation Economic Outcast, a US Treasury campaign launched in August with aims to cut off financial entities that help Iran evade sanctions. According to DefiLlama, the exchange held about $4.48 billion in total assets as of Friday. Cointelegraph contacted MEXC for comment but had not received a response by publication.

news.titleTr: How the deadly shooting in Krakow unfolded
news.summaryTr: Video authenticated by BBC Verify shows the moment gunshots rang out in Krakow's main market square.
news.articleText: How the deadly shooting in Krakow unfolded Six people were killed and several others injured when a gunman opened fire in central Krakow, Poland's second largest city, on Saturday. Footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows about a dozen people running inside two buildings before a black car with its front window open passes, followed by a police car. Another video shows the moment that gunshots were heard in the city's main market square. Poland's interior minister described the suspect - a 25-year-old Polish citizen - as being inspired by "far-right ideologies"; police said he used "military weapons" in the attack. Hours after the attack, Polish PM Donald Tusk said three other bodies were found at the suspect's home, which is still being searched.

news.titleTr: Binance’s finance chief Kaiser Ng to leave company, report says
news.summaryTr: Ng will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex.
news.articleText: Binance’s finance chief Kaiser Ng to leave company, report says Ng will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex. Binance’s finance chief Kaiser Ng is reportedly leaving that company to pursue a new venture. “Kaiser Ng has decided to pursue a new venture after more than five years at Binance, with a transition plan implemented over the last half year,” Binance co-CEO Yi He said in a statement obtained by Reuters on Saturday. Ng’s LinkedIn profile says he has been Binance’s chief financial officer since January 2022 and before that served in the same capacity at crypto exchange Kraken for about five years. He will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex, according to the report. The news comes a little more than a week after Binance was hacked for a record $6.3 billion. Cointelegraph reported that hackers stole about $6.3 billion from Binance on Oct. 29, in the largest cryptocurrency theft on record. Binance said it would absorb the losses rather than pass them on to customers. The attack has been attributed to North Korean hackers by the FBI and several researchers, a charge that country has denied. news.articleText: Traders 'priced out' of £12,000 Christmas market pitches - Published Traders claim they have been priced out of this year's Christmas market. They have told Liverpool City Council leader Liam Robinson that they cannot afford to take space at the event now that a new operator has taken over running it. Anthony Grice said he had been quoted £12,000 to take a stall at the St George's Plateau attraction. Robinson said he had met business owners to "understand the challenges and the issues that they might have had this year" so the authority could look at different options in future. He said the council had been aware of the price structure being offered to traders by the new operator, Underbelly, when it won the contract to run the event. And he added that the council would get a share of some of the income. But Grice said it felt like local traders' concerns were being "swept under the carpet" during a meeting to discuss the plans. He said: "I asked how many local traders had signed up, and the council didn't know". He added: "These markets should be a chance to showcase the best of what you've got, but not having the 'Scouse soul' there is so annoying. "Aren't our people good enough?" Jeweller Alex Healy, from Gateacre, rang a BBC Radio Merseyside phone-in to tell Robinson that she would not be returning to the market this year, despite having been a trader at previous markets since 2021. She said "It would cost me in the region of £14,000 to £15,000. I have the smallest hut available, but that price I physically cannot afford it." She said she was acutely aware of the cost-of-living crisis facing her customers, adding: "I don't want to raise my prices. I shouldn't have to." Robinson said he wanted entrepreneurs like Healy to succeed and invited her to meet him to look at ways the council could support her business. He added Underbelly had won the tender to run the market "on quality and price" and had a "track record of delivering these markets successfully in lots of other places across the country". Underbelly has been contacted for comment. The leader of the Liberal Democrat opposition group on the council, Carl Cashman, said £14,000 was "a rip-off". He added: "Small businesses are feeling the pinch at the moment, with rising business rates, inflation, and payroll costs, and consumers spending less. "So £14,000 is just a risk too big for them to take, and the market won't be as good for it." A Liverpool city council spokesperson said local traders would be able to sell artisan goods at a street market on Basnett Street running on each Saturday in November, plus at regular and pop-up markets in Lark Lane and Woolton Village in the run-up to Christmas. news.titleTr: Ex-FBI counterintelligence agent stole almost $2.5M in crypto
news.summaryTr: Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard.
news.articleText: Ex-FBI counterintelligence agent stole almost $2.5M in crypto Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard. A former FBI counterintelligence agent admitted to wire fraud and money laundering in stealing almost $2.5 million in cryptocurrency from unidentified adversarial nations and wallets that were under investigation. Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, used his investigative positions with access to FBI systems to steal cryptocurrency, then exchange and launder it through financial transactions to conceal its source and ownership. Yaroch made about 100 fraudulent transfers related to 35 FBI investigations, gaining $2,474,380.66 in proceeds, according to a news release from the US Attorney’s Office, Eastern District of Virginia on Thursday. He had earlier admitted to unauthorized transfers that involved about $1 million in digital assets, which was reported by Cointelegraph in August. Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard, according to the statement. The former agent admitted that his actions had compromised FBI investigations related to criminal groups and adversarial nations. Yaroch faces up to 20 years in prison. His sentencing is set for March 4, 2027. Magazine: AI agent disputes head to ‘Internet Court’ — and a jury of AI agents

news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements
news.articleText: Release Number 9322-26 CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a no-action letter addressing whether derivatives clearing organizations may use trust companies to conduct daily settlements with clearing members. According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

news.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
news.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
news.articleText: Release Number 9315-26 CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws. The lawsuit follows Utah’s decision to file civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-

items.summary: Jensen Huang also admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and says he will cooperate with a security investigation.

items.titleTr: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy
items.summaryTr: Jensen Huang also admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and says he will cooperate with a security investigation.
items.articleText: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports its CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The company, one of the most valuable in the world, said its board had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised, adding that the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company. Separately, Jensen Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang said he took "full responsibility" for what he did, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders. Nvidia is one of the world's largest companies and seen as central to making the hardware for emerging AI technologies, and Jensen Huang has been in charge of it for more than 30 years. He said: "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry." His statement continued: "Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, Nvidia's Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. "I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American." A separate statement issued by Nvidia's board of directors said it would begin an investigation in "light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort". It continued: "The Board prioritises US national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. "While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information." US President Donald Trump said he had not spoken to the Nvidia boss since news of the investigation emerged. "I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what's going on," Trump told reporters, adding that he had "done an amazing job for our country". The New York Times reported in late October that Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he now wished he had "acted on the intelligence" at the time, Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's an honourable guy." China has previously rejected allegations of an espionage operation targeting the Nvidia chief, describing the claims as "groundless speculation". Jensen Huang rescued Nvidia from almost going broke on more than one occasion, and he took a punt on AI a long time before the rest of the world did. His decision to make Nvidia chips, originally designed for gaming, become the best in the business for AI development, has now paid off in spades and the company is worth trillions. This is a big blow for a man who is renowned for being a workaholic, a perfectionist and someone who expects incredibly high standards from his staff. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, is linked to Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, providing chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta. The microchip manufacturer is worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever. US intelligence agencies had been monitoring Alice Huang and concluded that she was acting on behalf of the Chinese government, according to unnamed sources cited by the New York Times. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what information Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence. Alice Huang did not respond to the paper's request for comment. Last week, members of Congress wrote to Jensen Huang, asking him to appear before them in the light of the reported relationship. Three House Republican committee leaders asked the CEO to appear later in the month, to talk about Nvidia's "security protocols against foreign adversary espionage" given his reported relationship with Alice Huang. "Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC's [China's] access to sensitive US technology and information. "The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress," the letter said. Nvidia's AI chips have been a major focus of the rivalry between the US and China, and Washington has previously imposed controls on where its advanced products can be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted by Washington over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions. items.summary: Further details have emerged about two police officers hailed for preventing a Polish gunman from killing more.

items.titleTr: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says
items.summaryTr: Further details have emerged about two police officers hailed for preventing a Polish gunman from killing more.
items.articleText: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says - Published One of two surgeons who treated victims on the streets in the aftermath of a mass shooting in Krakow, Poland said his colleague "undoubtedly" saved the life of a gravely injured police officer. The pair were eating near the city's Main Market Square on Saturday when a gunman began firing at random, killing six people and injuring 15. The doctors raced to treat both the attacker and two officers shot while subduing the perpetrator. On Sunday, the officers - both hailed as "true heroes" by the prime minister for preventing further deaths - emerged from comas. Prosecutors launched a terror investigation after ministers previously said the 24-year-old Polish attacker - who remains in a critical condition - was apparently inspired by "far-right ideologies". A British national and Austrian woman were among those killed alongside four Poles. Professor Michal Pędziwiatr was having lunch with a colleague, named by local media as Dr Mateusz Wierdak, and their families in central Krakow when they heard gunshots. Pędziwiatr told the BBC: "We saw the shooting attack. And what a surgeon can do in a situation like this?... We decided to help the victims as soon as possible. "We rushed into the area where the shooting was and started our rescue, because there were no ambulances available, there were no professionals around." He said his colleague used his hand to stem the bleeding from the most injured policeman, allowing them to wait for an ambulance which transferred the officer to hospital. Pędziwiatr said they came to learn that one of those they treated was the apparent attacker. "As a doctor... it doesn't matter to me if it's a victim or a suspect," he said. "It's not our task to decide what to do with this guy... for us, it was another heavily injured victim, that's all." According to local media, Wierdak is a renowned surgeon in Krakow. The University Hospital in Krakow states Pędziwiatr is head of General, Oncological, Metabolic and Emergency Surgery. The police officers have been identified as senior constables Jakub Kulik and Artur Morański. The attacker has not yet been named by authorities. When his house was searched after the attack in central Krakow, the bodies of his parents and sister were found. The National Public Prosecutor's Office in Poland launched an investigation into the attack with a unit specialising in "terrorist offences" taking the lead. Separately, reports emerged that six Dublin Civil Defence volunteers also assisted in the aftermath of the shooting. James McConnell, an officer, told RTE News the group were on a city break and were close to the main square, external when the shooting happened. The volunteers who are trained to provide medical care immediately sought to help injured people, providing "CPR and haemorrhage control". Witnesses who were close to the attack described panic and confusion around the square as it unfolded. Ruby Catherine Warren, from London, heard gunfire and "yelled at my friends to run and we all sprinted for our lives". Not knowing where the gunman was - or if there was more than one - they "just kept sprinting", eventually finding a hotel to hide inside. Tom Brook, from West Yorkshire, was inside a McDonald's near the square when he heard "multiple gunshots and saw people running for cover". "I then walked into the square and saw paramedics working on someone outside [a shop] and there was a dead body covered in foil blankets 20 meters away," he said. The suspect wore full military tactical gear during the attack and was described as having a military-grade weapon - but the government said he was not a member of the Polish armed forces. Poland's Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said "everything suggests" the suspect was "fascinated by far-right ideologies" and held ultra-nationalist views. The rampage began shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) on Saturday in the historic centre of Krakow. Footage showed the attacker's vehicle speeding through the centre of the city, and people fleeing as the sound of gunfire rang out. The glass fronts of shops were shattered by bullets and a tram was shot at during the attack, which police say lasted for around three minutes. The mayor of Krakow said he had submitted an urgent request for the two officers injured while stopping the attacker to be awarded titles of honorary citizens of the city. Main Market Square reopened on Sunday evening after a security cordon was lifted. - Published11 hours ago - Published13 hours ago - Published1 day ago - Published1 day ago
